entries.cd2380741ddd2c7d: As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company, alongside its founding Digital Marketing Business, places the Fan Business Platform Business at the center as a growth business, and aims to build a position as an indispensable platformer for icons and fans in the entertainment market, both in Japan and overseas (especially South Korea). To this end, it states that it will expand icon acquisition into broader categories such as sports, and create monetization opportunities through active development and stronger customer success.
